{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_arm = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute fraction who responded
fraction_responded = treatment_arm['responded'].mean()

# Also compute counts
n_patients = len(treatment_arm)
n_responders = treatment_arm['responded'].sum()

# Print all required values
print(fraction_responded)
print(n_patients)
print(n_responders)"}
